<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Two columns that set life without the product against life with it, point by point. Axes: layout (cards: two
  cards, rows: one row per point), icons (show, hide), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Contrast, BeforeAfterLabels } from "./before-after.types";

export type BeforeAfterProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  points: Contrast[];
  labels: BeforeAfterLabels;
  layout?: "cards" | "rows";
  icons?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Card from "../primitives/card/card.vue";
import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  points,
  labels,
  layout = "cards",
  icons = "show",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<BeforeAfterProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density">
    <Grid v-if="((layout as string) === 'cards')" cols="1-2" class="items-stretch gap-4" data-testid="sides">
      <Card
        variant="muted"
        :class="cn('h-full', (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'gap-4 p-4' : ''))"
        data-testid="side"
        data-side="before"
      >
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ labels.before }}
          </Title>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0">
            <ListItem v-for="p in points" :key="p.id" class="flex items-start gap-4" data-testid="item">
              <LucideIcon v-if="((icons as string) === 'show')" name="x" :size="16" class="mt-1 shrink-0" />
              <Text size="sm">
                {{ p.before }}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card
        variant="default"
        :class="cn('h-full', (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'gap-4 p-4' : ''))"
        data-testid="side"
        data-side="after"
      >
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ labels.after }}
          </Title>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0">
            <ListItem v-for="p in points" :key="p.id" class="flex items-start gap-4" data-testid="item">
              <LucideIcon v-if="((icons as string) === 'show')" name="check" :size="16" class="mt-1 shrink-0" />
              <Text size="sm">
                {{ p.after }}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Grid>
    <Stack v-else gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="rows">
      <Grid v-for="p in points" :key="p.id"
        cols="1-3"
        :class="cn('items-center gap-4', 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4')"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
          {{ p.title }}
        </Text>
        <Group gap="2" align="start">
          <LucideIcon
            v-if="((icons as string) === 'show')"
            name="x"
            :size="16"
            class="mt-1 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
          />
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ p.before }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <Group gap="2" align="start">
          <LucideIcon
            v-if="((icons as string) === 'show')"
            name="check"
            :size="16"
            class="mt-1 shrink-0 text-primary"
          />
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ p.after }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
      </Grid>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
